Up to USD 50,000 (approximately ₹43,40,296) and other benefits

Google PhD Fellowship India Program 2026 is an opportunity offered by Google to support promising Ph.D. candidates of all backgrounds who seek to influence the future of technology. The program was created to recognise outstanding graduate students doing exceptional and innovative research in areas relevant to computer science and related fields. The selected fellows will receive up to USD 50,000 (approximately ₹43,40,296) to cover stipends and other research-related activities, travel expenses, including overseas travel for a 4-year fellowship and a Google research mentor.
To be eligible, an applicant must:
be enrolled full-time in the Ph.D. program
have obtained an undergraduate/master's degree from an Indian university
be a professional who is employed with a registered organisation in India
Google employees, and their spouses, children, and members of their households.
Students who are already supported by a comparable industry award (Government or non-profit organisation funding is exempt).
Past awardees from the Ph.D. Fellowship program.
The selected candidates will receive a fellowship in the following ways:
USD 50,000 (approximately ₹43,40,296) to cover stipend and other research-related activities, and travel expenses (including overseas travel)
USD 10,000 (approximately ₹8,68,121) to recognise research contributions, cover stipend and other research-related activities, and travel expenses (including overseas travel)
Short (one-page) resume/CV of the student applicant's primary PhD program advisor
Available transcripts (mark sheets) from the first year/semester of your Bachelor's degree to date.
2-3 letters of recommendation from people familiar with your work (at least one from your thesis advisor if you're a current PhD student).
Eligible candidates can apply by following these steps:
button and fill in the required registration
If already registered, log in using Gmail/Mobile number/Email ID.)
Get nominated by your eligible university during the application period; direct applications aren't accepted.
Contact your department or graduate school for your university's internal nomination process.
If nominated, your university submits the application for you via the portal (available on the program page when the period starts).
The selection will be based on the fulfilment of the eligible criteria.
The fellowships are awarded to students who represent the future of research in the following fields:
Machine Perception, Speech Technology and Computer Vision
Natural Language Processing (including Information Retrieval and Extraction)
Question: What is the Google PhD Fellowship India Program?

The Google PhD Fellowship India Program recognises and supports outstanding graduate students pursuing PhDs in computer science and related fields. It aims to foster innovation and strengthen the research community in India.
Question: Who is eligible to apply for the Google PhD Fellowship India Program?

To be eligible an applicant must be a full-time PhD student at an eligible university in India pursuing research in a relevant field (e.g., Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, etc.).
Question: What benefits does the Google PhD Fellowship India Program provide?
This fellowship offers the following benefits:
Potential opportunities for internships at Google.
Question: Where can I find the official application and program guidelines for the Google PhD Fellowship India Program?
The official information will be available on the Google Research website. Search for "Google PhD Fellowship India" on Google.
Question: Can I apply if I am in the early stages of my PhD program?
Yes, applications are often accepted from students at various stages of their PhD program. However, the selection committee will evaluate your research potential and progress.
